content:
elaine: quick note from a private-deploy review: our node-proxy container running hostNetwork:true can hit the kubelet on 127.0.0.1:10250 and list pods. seems like a local-info leak. can we triage? :grimacing:
mike: interesting. does it return secrets?
elaine: not secret contents, but it shows podSpecs, SA names, volume mounts and projected token mounts. enough to craft targeted exfil. reproduced on canary.
raj: immediate mitigation: 1) block egress to 127.0.0.1:10250 from that pod via node iptables + host firewall; 2) patch the deployment to remove hostNetwork by default. NetworkPolicy alone may not help for hostNetwork pods.
anya: add KMS audit check too: query decrypts by service account names surfaced in podSpec. if we see unexpected decrypts, rotate envelope keys.
sec-bot: alert: LOCAL_KUBELET_ENUM detected for installer-template v2024-03. Rule added to detection set.
mike: runbook items: - audit ClusterRoleBindings for edge/node-proxy SAs - apply temporary host-level deny rule on canary nodes - add preflight to reject hostNetwork unless explicitly whitelisted
elaine: I pushed a minimal repro and sanitized logs to the secure channel. will link here once scrubbed.
raj: i'll draft iptables commands for canary nodes and add to runbook: deny 127.0.0.1:10250 egress for proxy UID. also adding a Jira PRIV-EDGE-LOCAL-01 for tracking.
anya: KMS team: I'll hand over suspected SA names after we confirm no customer identifiers in the dump. expected query window: 2024-03-10T08:00Z..2024-03-10T12:00Z.
mike: communication plan: hold customer notifications until we confirm any decrypts. internal exec briefing if we see rotary key ops.
elaine: longer term: update installer templates to set hostNetwork:false by default and add an explicit justification field in helm values. also ensure the operator refuses to deploy hostNetwork pods without a sec-approved exception.
sec-bot: detection rule deployed by elaine at 2024-03-10T13:20:00Z.
raj: assigning owners: elaine (repro + detection), mike (CRB audit + comms), anya (KMS audit + rotation), raj (node firewall + installer fix). reconvene in 3 hours. :lock:
